# Kunal Mukherjee

> Human + AI strategist for marketing and brand teams, creator of The Human Line, and writer of the What the AI!? newsletter. Based in Mumbai. Not the Stanford professor, the Zillow computer scientist or the San Francisco poet of the same name.

## The Human Line, in one paragraph

Score any task 0 to 2 on five factors: reversibility, verification, confidentiality, judgment and who is affected. 0 to 3: Hand off (AI drafts and does it; a person spot-checks). 4 to 6: Team up (AI drafts; a person challenges, edits and approves). 7 to 10: Hold (AI may inform; a human decides). One override: spend, hiring, pricing, legal and anything published needs a named human's approval, whatever the score.
